name: Pearl Drop Earrings
description:
Experience the timeless elegance of our Pearl Drop Earrings. 

Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, this exquisite piece features:
• Premium White Gold construction for lasting beauty
• Genuine cultured pearls with brilliant luster
• Elegant drop design that elongates the face

Perfect for formal occasions or as a meaningful gift, this piece showcases exceptional craftsmanship and design.

Specifications:
• Material: 14k White Gold
• Color: White Gold with Pearl
• Weight: 6.7 grams
• Gemstone: Cultured Pearl

Care Instructions:
• Clean gently with a soft cloth
• Store in a jewelry box to prevent tarnishing
• Avoid contact with harsh chemicals and perfumes
• Wipe pearls with a damp cloth after wearing

Elevate your jewelry collection with this stunning piece that combines classic design with modern sophistication.
